race.comment: A very even running of the Hamilton Cup is run over 2200m. GRAND PIERRO (2) finished not far away in sixth when contesting the Ansett Classic at Mornington 2 weeks ago, and that form will stack up nicely in this field. He has won twice over the trip, and gets a big chance to bounce back into some worthwhile form in this. TIKEMYSON (15) had to cover too much ground in the Coleraine Cup over 1800m last start, and did well to finish where he did in eighth place. He will relish getting back out to 2200m, and can make amends. SHULTZY (11) ran on resolutely from well back in the Ansett Classic when finishing fifth, and he could settle a tad closer from the pole position this time. Stick with him on an each-way basis. THEDOCTOROFLOVE (4) is capable of a big form reversal. Include.
